title: Resident Only - Parking Permit Request
categories: Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns
description: Use this request to apply for a residential parking only permit: 1) due to parking congestion or 2) for Deep Ellum residents. Permits available only in certain areas for single family dwellings and Deep Ellum. ** Requestor must provide contact information ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 30 business days.

observedQuestions.prompt: Is this for a single family dwelling or deep ellum parking permit?

branches.Single family dwelling (house/duplex) pe: Ask what is causing parking congestion

observedQuestions.prompt: What is causing the parking congestion?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

detailsForm.completedContactPath: Single family dwelling permit; congestion = Other

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a residential or Deep Ellum parking permit.
actions.why: For a resident seeking a parking-only permit in an eligible single-family or duplex area because of parking congestion, or a Deep Ellum resident seeking a permit. The 311 request form asks for the permit type and vehicle plate, and asks single-family applicants what causes congestion. The description says contact information is required.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Resident Only - Parking Permit Request" requests does not apply outside eligible single-family dwelling areas or Deep Ellum.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns" > Choose "Resident Only - Parking Permit Request"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns" > Choose "Resident Only - Parking Permit Request"
